title: Student Results & Grading System
statement: Analyze the results of 5 students, each having marks in 3 subjects (Programming Fundamentals, Mathematics, and English), using nested loops and nested if-else statements. Requirements: 1. Outer loop for 5 students. 2. Inner loop to input marks for 3 subjects. 3. Validate marks between 0 and 100, re-prompting with an error message on invalid input. 4. Assign grades per subject (80-100: A, 70-79: B, 60-69: C, 50-59: D, <50: F). 5. Use nested if-else to check if all subjects are at least 50 to pass. 6. Display each student's marks, grades, total out of 300, percentage, and Pass/Fail status.
hints: Carefully review the requirements in FAST_CL1002_F26_LAB10_P1.
Use standard C++ PF-lab constructs (nested loops, basic arrays, no banned STL).

title: Cafeteria Billing System
statement: Calculate bills for 4 cafeteria customers, each purchasing 3 items, using nested loops. Requirements: 1. Outer loop for 4 customers. 2. Inner loop for 3 item prices. 3. Reject zero or negative prices and re-prompt. 4. Use nested if-else after computing subtotal: if subtotal >= Rs. 5,000, apply 15% discount with membership card or 10% without; if subtotal < Rs. 5,000, apply 5% discount with membership card or 0% without. 5. Display subtotal, discount amount, and final bill for each customer. 6. Display total revenue collected after discounts across all customers.
hints: Carefully review the requirements in FAST_CL1002_F26_LAB10_P2.
Use standard C++ PF-lab constructs (nested loops, basic arrays, no banned STL).
